headerDisplay: This plugin exposes Hikvision AX Pro alarm subsystems and zones to HomeKit as security systems and motion sensors.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name for this platform instance as it appears in the Homebridge logs.

host.title: Panel IP Address or Hostname
host.description: The IP address or hostname of your Hikvision AX Pro panel.

username.title: Username
username.description: Username for authenticating with the AX Pro panel.

password.title: Password
password.description: Password for authenticating with the AX Pro panel.

userLevel.title: User Level
userLevel.description: Access level for the API connection. Use 1 for admin/operator level (recommended).

pollingInterval.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
pollingInterval.description: How often to poll the panel for status updates. Lower values provide faster updates but increase network traffic.
